cover: In this video we are going to see how to get a company's LinkedIn URL using LinkFinder AI.
payoff: That's Better Mortgage's real LinkedIn company page: their official LinkedIn page, found in about three seconds. Go to the first link in the description to try it yourself.
outro: That's how to get a company's LinkedIn URL, for one company or a whole list. Your next step: open the first link in the description and run your own list.
outroSub: Free account, credits included. First link in the description.

mocks._source: Real results from the LinkFinder AI API (data/lookups.json), checked by tools/gen360.py

click.text: I just need one lookup for now

steps.narration: Searching LinkedIn by hand gives you franchise pages, old pages and lookalikes. The company's real page is the one every other lookup should start from. LinkFinder AI looks up the real value for the company you name. Here's exactly how, one click at a time.
Now the company website. Pick company website.
Same company, Better Mortgage. Enrich.
There it is: better dot com.
Now the phone number. Click Change. Pick phone number.
Same company, Better Mortgage. Enrich.
Now the contact email. Click Change. Pick contact email.

click.text: A company's contact email, from its name

steps.narration: Same company, Better Mortgage. Enrich.
There it is: info at better dot com.
Step one. Click Change, then click More searches.
Step two. Pick a company's LinkedIn company page, from its name. It costs one credit.

click.text: A company's LinkedIn page, from its name

steps.narration: Step three. Type the company name: Better Mortgage.
Step four. Click Enrich Data.
There it is: their official LinkedIn page. The real one, not a guess.
Checking companies one at a time is fine for one pitch. For a whole list, click Change, pick the same lookup, and switch to Upload CSV.

click.text: A company's LinkedIn page, from its name

steps.narration: Select your file. One column of company names. Ours has 6.
You see every row before anything runs, so you know exactly what it costs.
Click Process 6 items.
Every row gets the exact same lookup. The LinkedIn company pages fill in one by one.
6 companies in, 6 LinkedIn company pages out, each marked Found. Export it as a CSV in one click.
Your list already lives in Google Sheets? The add-on runs the same lookups right in the column, no export, no re-import.
Want it in your own tools? Click API and MCP in the top menu. Same lookup, one call, the answer comes straight back.
And every lookup lands in History, so you can see what you found, when, and what it cost.
